d:
Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav personally dropped senior party leader Azam Khan at Lucknow airport after the party's manifesto launch and dinner. This was their first meeting since Azam Khan's release from jail. The special gesture, along with the importance given to Azam at the party event, has sparked discussions about his possible role in the SP's preparations for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections.
